# Render complete drop affordances for default dock targets

## Context and problem

A real Workstation Metrics popup on merged `8d6c4216` returns an accepted drop preview from its default Participation hover path but paints no preview or drop menu. The replacement full PopupWorkspace lost the affordances the earlier vessel mounted; the root remains a positive control with a DropIndicators instance.

Live reproduction: open Metrics using its header pop-out action, call the popup Participation's `defaultPreviewFor({draggedItem:{dockItemId:'audit'}, localX:200, localY:180})` after geometry warms, and observe accepted `neo.dock.preview.v1` for `workstation-vessel-tabs:metrics`. Its owned renderer still has `dockPreview:null`, its controller has `indicators:null`, and the popup's indicator query is empty. This is production-path AppWorker evidence after a real pop-out, not a full native-transfer receipt.

## Architectural reality and fix

`src/dashboard/dock/window/Participation.mjs#resolveAffordances` owns the default Preview and DragAffordances. It creates no DropIndicators; `defaultPreviewFor` resolves a preview without publishing it. The existing `interaction/DragAffordances.mjs` already owns local candidate selection and painting, and `interaction/DropIndicators.mjs` owns menu geometry and pointer selection.

Complete that default composition using those existing owners. Share candidate selection and preview publication between the synchronous remote-hover path and local drag path, preserving the controller's geometry-generation fences. Retire default-owned overlays with their Participation; caller-supplied callbacks remain caller-owned. Reuse the relevant renderer-publication work from Emmy's unmerged `b947033b`, adapted to the registered PreviewContract from #18392. No new helper class or consumer overlay implementation is needed.

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Participation default hover | Existing Preview / DragAffordances / DropIndicators composition | Accepted preview and candidate menu reach the same owned rendered overlays | Geometry unavailable or retired owner yields no preview | Changed method/config JSDoc | Unit ownership controls and rendered popup |
| DragAffordances | Existing candidate policy and registered PreviewContract | Local and remote paths share candidate selection and painting | Clear invalidates geometry and feedback | Method JSDoc | Candidate-selection regression and stale-geometry controls |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029's shared affordance/preview separation; no wire or authority amendment. Structural pre-flight: no new or relocated module. Agent OS structure map: N/A, existing Engine owners only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-1: default Participation owns one Preview and one DropIndicators through its existing DragAffordances, reused over hover calls.
- [ ] AC-2: local and default remote hover share the existing candidate grammar, pointer selection and renderer publication; accepted target previews paint the menu and target region without consumer callback copies.
- [ ] AC-3: clear/destroy and stale asynchronous geometry cannot leave active feedback; only default-owned overlays are destroyed.
- [ ] AC-4: existing local drag, explicit callback, policy and geometry tests remain green; regression tests fail against the pre-fix source.
- [ ] AC-5: a rendered Workstation popup demonstrates accepted default hover, visible menu/preview, selection and cleanup while its document remains unchanged during hover. State precisely whether dispatch is through Neural Link or a human drag.

## Out of scope

Native embodiment/staging choreography (the separate `3a640d6d` change), full native-transfer repair, independent full roots, Workspace decomposition, new placement grammar/schema, theme redesign, Brain or tooling changes. This leaf repairs visible target affordances; it does not certify all remaining #18303 product acceptance.

## Avoided traps and prior art

Do not add Workstation-specific overlay copies or a second candidate controller. Memory Core `149ef22a-615b-4e6d-b5ac-0ea2a59686cc` records the earlier standalone-demo move toward this shared controller; that work excluded native/cross-window reintegration. #18121 instead owns older native-popup placement/claim instability and is not this missing default composition.

Live latest-20 open issue, own-assignment and latest-30 all-status A2A sweeps repeated immediately before creation; no equivalent leaf found. Emmy explicitly released this surface to Euclid at 19:46Z and remains on #18393. Ask/KB tooling is excluded by current operator direction.
